title: Choices Paradox
description: At the start of each combat, add 1 of 5 random cards into your Hand. Add Retain to the chosen card.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Triggers on the player's first turn of combat. Generates 5 random cards from the character's card pool, applies Retain keyword to each, and the player selects 1 card to add to their hand.
